title: DIS master export (CDSL DP, DIS_MSTR)
purpose: Delivery instruction slips CDSL holds as issued to each BO, with their status (active, used, cancelled, lost …).
linked: Matched to the DIS books issued: slips CDSL has cancelled or blocked are marked lost so they cannot be accepted, and differences go to the work queue
source: CDSL UDiFF Catalogue V3.0.1.4, sheet Field Master, information type DIS_Master_Export (20 fields; names, types and standard values); header and values checked against CDSL's sample file DIS_MSTR_041400_121_F_202512311455_001.csv (2 rows)

columns.name: DisInstrId
columns.note: DIS Instruction ID; INTEGER(12); the catalogue says INTEGER(12) but CDSL's sample file has 'PRA 101', so it is read as text

columns.name: DISIssdToClntOrPwrOfAttnyHldr
columns.note: DIS issued to Client or POA Holder / Issue entity; CHAR(3)

columns.name: SrcClntIdOrBnfclOwnrId
columns.note: Source Client ID / BO ID; CHAR(16)

codes.USE: DIS Used in a Transaction / Used
codes.IBC: Inactive DIS Due TO BO Closure in EOD
codes.RDC: Revoke DIS Issuance Cancellation by Checker
codes.DCM: DIS Cancellation by Maker-Lost, Misplace etc
codes.CAN: DIS Cancellation Approved by Checker / Cancelled
codes.DSC: DIS Issuance Setup Approved by Checker / Active
codes.DCR: DIS Cancelled Due to Request From CDSL
codes.RDM: Revoke DIS Issuance Cancellation by Maker

columns.name: DISISDTxTp
columns.note: DIS Issued to Transaction Type; CHAR(3); Refer Standard Value List Not applicable for CDSL

codes.DFP: Delivery Free of Payment Instruction / Transaction
codes.IDO: Irreversible Delivery Out Instruction / Early Pay-in

columns.name: DISCxlFlg
columns.note: DIS CANCELLATION FLAG /Reason Code for DIS Status; CHAR(2)

codes.LD: Cancellation Due to Lost DIS / Stollen DIS

columns.name: DISBookltTp
columns.note: DIS Booklet Type / Issuance Type Flag; CHAR(3)

columns.name: StsChngRsn
columns.note: Status change reason; CHAR(50); DIS Status change reason Not applicable for CDSL
